name: Blue Hill at Stone Barns
dinnerNote: Multi-taste feast from the farm, no set menu; prepaid, plus tax and a 22% administrative fee

menus.name: Multi-taste feast
menus.note: No menu: the best of the field and market; most bookings start with a walking tour of the farm; prepaid when you book, drinks paid on the day

alsoTry.name: Blue Hill Cafeteria at Stone Barns
alsoTry.note: The farm's cafeteria, also booked on Tock and suggested for families with children

dressCode: Elegant: jackets are recommended but not required, and shorts are strongly discouraged. Closed-toe shoes are suggested for walking round the farm.
children: The length of the meal makes it hard for young children to enjoy, and there's no children's menu; families are encouraged to try Blue Hill Cafeteria instead.
bookingOpens: On Tock only. Tables are released one month at a time on the 15th of the month before.
waitlist: If your day or time is full, join the waiting list on Tock.
cancellation: All sales are final: bookings are prepaid and can't be cancelled. Gratuities aren't accepted; the 22% administrative fee replaces them.
groups: The private dining room seats up to 12 and is booked on Tock; for 20 or more, call 914-366-9606 ext. 226.
byob: You can bring wines that aren't on the wine list: one 750ml bottle per two guests, at $150 a bottle.
